jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Business Enablement

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.

You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

Your responsibilities will include:

Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

jobs.description:
Head of Finance & Accounting

Weir Minerals

Mississauga, Ontario or Salt Lake City, UT

Hybrid

What We Do At Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your Impact

The Head of Finance and Accounting is a highly visible leadership position responsible for managing the organization’s financial control environment and ensuring compliance with IFRS, Group Financial Guidelines and local Statutory Accounting and regulatory requirements across the region.

This role oversees end-to-end accounting operations, including monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, and holds accountability for working capital and balance sheet forecasting, Balance Sheet and treasury management, and intercompany processes to maintain financial integrity.

In addition, the Head of F&A drives the harmonization and standardization of finance processes in line with divisional standards, ensuring robust governance and audit readiness across the business. Acting as a subject matter expert and key liaison for internal and external stakeholders, this individual combines exceptional technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities to build and develop a high-performing accounting organization, lead transformational initiatives, and foster a culture of compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

What you'll do:

Financial Governance & Compliance: Lead the management of the financial control environment across NAM, ensuring compliance with IFRS, Group Financial Guidelines, and local statutory requirements. Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, maintain audit readiness, and manage treasury operations including cash flow and FX risk mitigation. Success means maintaining financial integrity and robust governance with zero compliance issues. Travel will be occasional across the region to support audit and stakeholder engagement.
Process Improvement & Standardization: Drive harmonization and standardization of finance processes (R2R, P2P, OTC) to transition from fragmented regional operations to a consistent, efficient model. Lead initiatives to improve operational effectiveness and embed new ways of working in partnership with Weir Business Services.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a confident and effective business partner, collaborating closely with Finance Centers of Excellence, Regional Finance Directors, Commercial Finance teams, and Group Functional Leaders to ensure alignment and optimal service delivery.
Team Leadership & Transformation: Build and lead a high-performing Finance & Accounting team, fostering a culture of compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Champion employee development and lead change management initiatives to embed finance transformation across the region
Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world class safety culture.

What you'll bring:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. *Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration ideal.
Professional certification such as CPA, ACCA, or equivalent.
10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership managing multi-country operations.
Deep expertise in IFRS, statutory reporting, internal controls, audit management, and SAP ERP systems.
Experience leading finance transformation initiatives, including process standardization and centralization.
Strong background in treasury operations, FX risk management, and working capital optimization.
Familiarity with tax compliance, transfer pricing, and e-invoicing requirements across diverse regulatory environments.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

The Senior Director, People Strategy & Business Initiatives is a strategic leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer. This role is designed to increase the strategic capacity of the CHRO and HR Leadership Team by connecting people strategy, organization design, talent strategy, people insights, HR modernization, and future-of-work capabilities into one integrated enterprise agenda.

The Senior Director will serve as a trusted advisor to the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, and other key stakeholders to advance priority business and people initiatives. The role leads a direct report and may provide indirect leadership to cross-functional project teams and external partners.

The role focuses on shaping fit-for-purpose operating models, strengthening organization design, simplifying how work gets done, enabling AI and technology-driven solutions, and translating people insights into clear recommendations for senior leaders.

Organization Design and Operating Model Strategy

Lead organization design and operating model work, including spans and layers analysis, role clarity, decision rights, governance, and ways of working.
Partner with the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, HRBPs, and business leaders to determine structures, capabilities, and accountabilities required to support business objectives.
Develop practical organization design principles, tools, and standards to support consistent, fact-based decisions across functions, geographies, and divisions.
Use internal insights, external benchmarks, and business context to challenge current models and recommend simpler, more agile, and more effective ways of operating.

HR Modernization, Future of Work and AI Enablement

Identify where process simplification, technology, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and stronger data can improve HR quality, speed, consistency, and employee experience.
Lead or support key HR and business initiatives that simplify governance, service delivery, decision-making forums, and ways of working.
Assess emerging trends in AI, skills, workforce planning, employee experience, analytics, and HR service delivery, and translate them into practical opportunities for Saputo.
Promote continuous improvement across HR by reducing complexity, eliminating duplication, clarifying accountabilities, and increasing work effectiveness.

Talent Strategy and Succession Management

Support the enterprise talent agenda by connecting talent insights, succession risks, workforce planning, internal mobility, and organization design implications to Saputo’s business strategy.
Partner with the HRBPs, division talent leaders, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and Total Rewards to ensure talent discussions are informed by business priorities, workforce needs, and clear data.
Support preparation of CHRO, Executive Leadership Team, and Board-level materials related to talent pipeline, succession risks, critical roles, workforce capability, and organizational health.

Connect data from talent, workforce planning, organization design, employee listening, HR systems, and business indicators to build stronger people insights.
Translate data, benchmarks, and trends into clear implications, options, and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Partner with HR Systems to improve data quality, reporting discipline, dashboard usefulness, and analytics maturity.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support

Prepare executive-ready insights, options, recommendations, and discussion materials for CHRO, HR Leadership Team, Executive Leadership Team, and Board-related discussions.
Facilitate senior-level discussions on operating model choices, talent risks, workforce scenarios, organization design, and HR modernization priorities.
